description: Central Province Provincial Council - The Standard By-laws on Praja Mandala and Monitoring of them within the P.S Divisions of Central Province
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of standard by-laws for establishing and regulating Praja Mandalas (community organizations) within Pradeshiya Sabha divisions. It references specific legislation (Local Government Authorities Act, No. 06 of 1952 and Provincial Councils Act, No. 12 of 1989) and establishes regulatory frameworks for registration, functions, and governance of these organizations. While it mentions a government official (Sarath Ekanayake), the core content is about creating legal/regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganization, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette.
